headline: Richard Csaky pushes ARC-2 score to 60

sections.text: Richard Csaky added 29.03 points to reach 60.00, moving from 658th to 11th on ARC-AGI-2.
That puts the climb inside the contest’s 15 gold places, with a wide cushion over the current cutoff.
